title: Covered Due Dates, Plan Months and End Date of a Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit
content:
**Clause.** For a Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit of the Hardship Assistance Programs, the covered due dates are the loan due dates from the military service start date through the latest due date carrying a plan installment line on the benefit, counted as whole calendar months from the start date to that due date plus one, together with every loan due date after that line and on or before the end of military service, counted as whole calendar months from that due date to the end of military service; a month counts as complete only when the later date reaches the earlier date's day of the month, several lines on one due date count that due date once, and a benefit with no plan installment line covers no due date. The plan months recorded are the covered due dates.

Every graduated-return due date that applies is added to the covered due dates; the graduated-return due dates follow the last covered due date one month apart, and the last of them is the end date recorded, while a benefit with no graduated-return due date records its last covered due date as its end date. A benefit with no plan installment line records no plan months at all, 0, whatever any other rule of this policy would add, and records the end of military service as its end date.

## Worked case (hypothetical dates, loan due on the 15th)

Service start 20 March; latest plan installment line on 15 June; end of military service 10 August.

| Part | Count |
|---|---|
| Start date to the latest line: 20 March to 15 June is 2 whole months (15 June does not reach the 20th), plus one | 3 (15 April, 15 May, 15 June) |
| Due dates after that line and on or before the end of service: 15 June to 10 August is 1 whole month | 1 (15 July) |
| Covered due dates | 4 |

With no graduated-return due date, 4 plan months are recorded and the end date is 15 July, the last covered due date. With two graduated-return due dates, 6 plan months are recorded and the end date is 15 September.

A benefit with the same dates but no plan installment line records 0 plan months and the end date 10 August.
